statuses.1: Quote -- unbound quote, no coverage yet
statuses.5: PendingCancel -- cancel requested, not yet effective
statuses.13: EndorsementScenario -- endorsement quote staged for review
statuses.30: RenewalOffer -- renewal offer presented to insured

status_triggers.13: Endorsement initiated by agent -- staged for review
status_triggers.36: ProcessSuspense WebJob, manual hold for payment
status_triggers.37: UW rule flagged -- routes to NeedsUnderwriterReview queue
status_triggers.54: Commercial bind request submitted, pending UW review

bind.label: Bind
bind.definition: Convert a quote (status=1) into an active policy (status=2). Payment is collected, coverage becomes effective. Triggers BindPolicy command -> bindquote-msg-queue -> MonitorQueues WebJob.

endorse.label: Endorse
endorse.definition: Mid-term policy change after binding. Examples: address change, coverage change, add mortgagee. Creates EndorsementScenario (status=13), then binds via bindendorsement-msg-queue.

fnol.label: FNOL
fnol.definition: First Notice of Loss. The initial report of a claim event by the insured. Triggers FNOL submission -> Snapsheet -> initiate-fnol-submission-msg-queue.

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.definition: Terminate coverage before policy expiration. Types: non-pay cancel (NPC), company request cancel, insured request cancel. Routes through requestcancel-msg-queue or nonpaycancel-msg-queue.

reinstate.label: Reinstate
reinstate.definition: Restore a cancelled policy. Only valid within reinstatement window. Routes through reinstatement-msg-queue.

renew.label: Renew
renew.definition: Issue a new policy term when current term expires. RenewalOffer WebJob creates the offer; Renewals WebJob processes the bind.

nonpay_cancel.label: Non-Pay Cancel
nonpay_cancel.definition: Cancellation triggered by missed payment. NonPayCancel WebJob + BillingNOP WebJob. Insured gets grace period before final cancel.

rewrite.label: Rewrite
rewrite.definition: Cancel current policy and create a new one, typically for major changes or product migrations. Routes through rewrite-msg-queue.

quote.label: Quote
quote.definition: A priced but unbound insurance application. Status=1. No coverage until bound. Expires if not bound.

premium.label: Premium
premium.definition: The price charged for insurance coverage. Calculated by RatingService using product-specific rate books.

deductible.label: Deductible
deductible.definition: The amount the insured pays out-of-pocket before insurance pays. Part of the policy coverage terms.

pje.label: PJE
pje.definition: Process Job Execution. The audit trail for every async background job. Visible at /Admin/ProcessJobExecution.

acord.label: ACORD
acord.definition: Insurance data interchange standard. MSI uses ACORD XML for Widget<->API communication. AcordBM.cs is the 10k-line translation layer.

master_policy.label: Master Policy
master_policy.definition: A community-level policy covering multiple units (apartment complex). Individual tenants get certificates underneath. MasterController handles this.

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.definition: An individual tenant's coverage document under a master policy. Part of the GroupRenters product.

surplus_lines.label: Surplus Lines
surplus_lines.definition: Insurance placed with non-admitted (E&S) carriers. Requires surplus lines tax reporting via InsCipher. HomeownersES products are surplus lines.

admitted.label: Admitted
admitted.definition: Insurance placed with state-regulated carriers. HomeownersAdmitted products. More regulated than E&S.

es.label: E&S
es.definition: Excess & Surplus. Non-admitted insurance. Less regulated. HomeownersESHO3, HomeownersESHO5, HomeownersESMS, HomeownersESREI.

pmc.label: PMC
pmc.definition: Property Management Company. Manages apartment communities. GroupRenters and AppFolio integrations serve PMC clients.

dta.label: DTA
dta.definition: Direct-to-Agent. A flood portal variant where the agent is the primary user.

dtc.label: DTC
dtc.definition: Direct-to-Consumer. A flood portal variant where the end customer self-serves.

moratorium.label: Moratorium
moratorium.definition: A geographic restriction on writing new policies, typically after a natural disaster. MoratoriumController + Moratorium WebJob.

ofac.label: OFAC
ofac.definition: Office of Foreign Assets Control. Sanctions screening on new policies. OFAC WebJob + commercial-ofac-validation-msg-queue.

clue.label: CLUE
clue.definition: Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange. LexisNexis integration that pulls prior claims history during underwriting.

suspense.label: Suspense
suspense.definition: A policy hold status (code=36) where automated processing is paused. ProcessSuspense WebJob resolves them.

nonrenewal.label: Non-Renewal
nonrenewal.definition: Decision not to renew a policy at expiration. PendingNonRenewal -> NonRenewal WebJob -> nonrenewal-msg-queue.

commission.label: Commission
commission.definition: Compensation paid to agents for written premium. CommissionService + AgencyCommissionDownload WebJob.

installment.label: Installment
installment.definition: A payment plan where premium is paid in scheduled partial amounts. Installment WebJob processes scheduled charges.

econsent.label: eConsent
econsent.definition: Electronic consent to receive policy documents via email instead of paper. EConsentNotification WebJob.
